name: Albalate de las Nogueras (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of purple, white and purple with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Albalate de las Nogueras (a castle on red, a bridge on blue and walnut trees on green).
history: Municipal flag of Albalate de las Nogueras; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Albalate de las Nogueras arms — castle, bridge and walnut trees
